submitted.rationale: Index 23 (Mg0.33Sb0.67) matches the MgSb2O6 1:2 composition. Its XRD shows a clean single-phase pattern. It had the highest measured EQE, 0.0173%. Response rises toward the Sb-rich side and appears to peak near the 1:2 stoichiometry.

rejected.reason: Excess Sb gives extra XRD peaks (secondary phase); EQE 0.0147%, lower than index 23
